svg.title: The Cocktail Cabinet — illustrative dark-mode Discover page
svg.desc: A faithful illustration of the desktop interface with Bordeaux and champagne accents, a left sidebar, Discover heading, My Shelf banner, filters and three photo-led cocktail cards. The photos are bundled public sample images.
svg.text: A home for every Negroni, spritz and after-dinner experiment.
Choose what you own. Discover what you can make.
